title: Water shutoff planned Friday night for valve work at McPherson and Del Mar
excerpt: The City of Laredo Utilities Department will replace a valve at McPherson Road and Del Mar Boulevard starting Friday night, Nov. 13, with water service possibly interrupted overnight into Saturday.
content:
The City of Laredo Utilities Department is planning a water shutoff starting Friday night, Nov. 13, 2026, to replace a valve at the intersection of McPherson Road and Del Mar Boulevard, according to KGNS.

The work is scheduled to begin at 10 p.m. Friday and is expected to continue through Saturday, Nov. 14, with the shutoff possibly lasting overnight, KGNS reported.

As of Thursday evening, the city had not said which specific neighborhoods would be affected, and it was not yet clear whether water would be completely shut off or only at reduced pressure in the area around the work site, according to KGNS.

Residents in the area should prepare for a possible water interruption overnight. The city posts updates on its water outage map, and KGNS said it would update its story as more information becomes available.

Update — Thursday, Nov. 12, 9:29 p.m.: The City of Laredo Utilities Department said Thursday night that crews are isolating valves at E. Del Mar Boulevard and McPherson Road. The department did not say whether the work is part of the planned Friday-night valve replacement or how long it will take.

Update — Friday, Nov. 13, 12:30 a.m.: Water is shut off tonight in Districts 5 and 6 for the valve work at E. Del Mar Boulevard and McPherson Road, according to a Utilities Department alert shared Thursday night. The shutoff began between 9:30 and 10 p.m., with repairs estimated at 6 to 8 hours and service expected back around 5 to 6 a.m. Friday. A separate city notice put the District 5 valve work at 8 to 12 hours starting at 9 p.m., and the city’s outage map showed 7 active water outages and 4 sewer repairs as of 8:20 p.m. Thursday.

Sources: KGNS; City of Laredo Utilities Department, Nov. 12, 2026.
